conservation.condition_narrative: "Sprayed by Mrs. Keck 1949 with butyl methacrylate polymer" (Keck typed label).
conservation.report_notes: Published with corresponding artwork entry in *Georgia O’Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné* (Lynes, 1999), this historical conservation information documents treatment decisions made during the artist’s lifetime. Lynes quotes information found on backing labels, and, when noted, from other sources.

remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "Painted in 1924. . . . Note: Miss O'Keeffe says this definitely painted in 1924." Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks date 1924. Dated 1923 on basis of inclusion in 1924 New York (Anderson) exhibition. Reproduced and titled *Painting*, in *Playboy* (July 1924). (Source: Lynes, 1999)
